subject: SORT statement
notes: w70c (kb/Work PB1174 landed). cite.py --check 14.9.40.4 'The number of occurrences of table elements referenced by data-name-2 is determined by the rules in the OCCURS clause' -> OK 14.9.40.4 20); cite.py --check 13.18.38.4 'The value of the data item referenced by data-name-1 represents the current number of occurrences of the subject of the entry' -> OK 13.18.38.4 7). BoundTableSort now carries the table's CURRENT occurrence count (the AllCount model, from the one ReferenceResolver.CurrentOccurrenceCount that table(ALL) also reads) and EmitTableSort sorts only that span in place: CobolTable.SortInPlace over AsSpan(table, 0, OdoExtent(N...)) for OCCURS DEPENDING (clamped, EC-BOUND-ODO outside per GR7), the whole array for a fixed table, CobolDynTable.CurrentOccurrences for a dynamic-capacity table. Measured on the w70c build: podo (N = 3 of 1 TO 5, 30 10 50 05 01) -> 10 30 50 05 01 (pre-fix 01 05 10 30 50); DESCENDING at N = 4 -> 50 30 10 05; N = 7 under EC-BOUND-ODO checking -> RAISED, table unchanged. Sibling: a dynamic-capacity table (OCCURS DYNAMIC, 2023) was REFUSED as data-name-2 (COBOL1757, the binder asked for a fixed integer) though SR13 requires only an OCCURS clause; it now sorts its current capacity (golden 2023/w70c_pb1174_table_sort_dynamic_capacity). || editions: 2002, 2014, 2023
